author: Renia
description: Some descriptions taken from the Fandom and Mirahaze wiki.

items.desc: The achievement "Complete Arsenal" requires you to wield every weapon at least one. That's right, *wield* meaning before you checkmark it, take the weapon out, make a swing or two for safety and *then* you can check it. Trust me, it sucked having to go through every single weapon cuz I could not remember which one I didn't pull out.
items.name: !! IMPORTANT !!

items.desc: The first weapon you'll obtain in the game, in front of the statue at the beginning of the Hollow Basin.
items.name: Replica Sword

items.desc:
On the way to the Temple of Silence.

Can be evolved into the Iron Torch.
items.name: Torch

items.desc:
Found in the hallway leading to the Fetid Mire.

Can be evolved into the Iron Club, which can then be evolved into the Steel Club.
items.name: Stone Club

items.desc:
Bought from Sheryl the Crow.

Can be evolved into the Silver Rapier.
items.name: Rapier

items.desc: Bought for 75 coins.
items.name: Steel Needle

items.desc:
Can be bought from Sheryl for 75 coins.
If not bought, it's located in the lower floor of Castle Le Fanu.

It can evolve into the Double Crossbow.
items.location: Wing's Rest, Sheryl the Crow / Castle Le Fanu
items.name: Crossbow

items.desc: Found inside the Altar Room.
items.name: Ritual Dagger

items.desc: South of the Mirage.
items.name: Steel Spear

items.desc: Behind a fake wall in the altar room.
items.name: Wooden Shield

items.desc:
Found hanging from a tree in the Yosei Forest, just shoot at it with a range weapon.

Can evolve into the Elfen Longsword.
items.name: Elfen Sword

items.desc: Floor level of the Yosei Forest.
items.name: Elfen Bow

items.desc: Right before the door towards The Sanguine Sea.
items.name: Battle Axe

items.desc:
Inside one of the underwater pipes of the Underworks.

Can evolve into the Fire Sword, which is a genuinely good weapon.
items.name: Broken Hilt

items.desc: Found on top of one of the four pillars in front of Castle Le Fanu.
items.name: Corrupted Dagger

items.desc: Under the bridge leading to the Castle Le Fanu.
items.name: Dark Rapier

items.desc: Found behind a fake wall in the Forbidden Archives's third floor.
items.name: Wolfram Greatsword

items.desc: Behind a fake wall north of where the abyssal demon is/was, at the entrance.
items.name: Twisted Staff

items.desc:
Behind a secret wall in the tomb of Ophelia.

Upon attacking an enemy with the Blade of Ophelia, the player gains back regeneratable health, similar to that of the health lost when Bleeding.
items.name: Blade of Ophelia

items.desc:
Found behind a fake wall in the Cattle Cells of Castle Le Fanu. Last cell on the right, after entering through the second blood door.

Deals random elemental damage.
items.name: Wand of Power

items.desc: All the way north west. Near the end of the area.
items.name: Marauder Black Flail

items.desc:
Located in the lower area of the Sand Tempill (not underground!)

Can evolve into the Steel Claw which can then evolve into the Poison Claw.
items.name: Iron Claw

items.desc: Finish floor 50.
items.name: Moonlight

items.desc:
After opening Garrat the Hound's cell and speaking to him, you'll see the weapon there.

Not required for the achievement.
items.name: Hammer of Cruelty

items.desc: Northeast of the warp crystal, go down the stairs then through the northern passage. While in the open area, hug the left wall until you reach the room containing the spear.
items.name: Fishing Spear

items.desc:
Found in the middle section of the Terminus Prison, behind a locked cell door. Can be seen from the Warp Crystal's room.
It's evolution is the repaired version.
items.name: Broken Lance

items.desc:
Found in the Water Temple, behind a fake wall near the drop down.

Can be evolved into the Saint Ishii.
items.name: Obsidian Seal

items.desc:
In the earth dungeon of the Forlorn Arena, head to the southwestern most dirt path and then head north west to find a fake wall with the Shadow Blade at the end.

It can be evolved into the Shining Blade.
items.name: Shadow Blade

items.location: Grave of the Sleeper: Calamis Cerulean of Lyria (after defeating Sucsarius).
items.name: Lucid Blade

items.desc: Does Light elemental damage.
items.name: Silver Rapier

items.desc:
Evolution of the Broken Hilt.
One of the best fire weapons in the game.
items.name: Fire Sword

items.desc: Can be evolved into the Steel Club.
items.name: Iron Club

items.location: Evolution of the Iron (and Stone) club.
items.name: Steel Club

items.desc: Can be evolved into the Poison Claw.
items.name: Steel Claw

items.location: Evolution of the Steel (and Iron) Claw.
items.name: Poison Claw

items.desc: Does split dark and fire damage.
items.name: Saint Ishii

items.desc: You can change back to the Shadow Blade at the oil fountain if you so do desire.
items.name: Shining Blade

items.desc: Behind a gate that requires the Light element to be used on it.
items.name: Halberd

items.desc:
The sword is located in the Accursed Tomb, but is behind a locked door. To reach the locked area, you must find the entrance of it in the Catacombs.
For directions: Enter the catacombs and head all the way North until you hit a wall with the blue fire/water marker. Hug that wall and move to the west. Once the wall ends, keep hugging it to enter a small pocket which is a closed linear path towards the stairs leading towards the vampire sword.
items.name: Vampire Hunter Sword

items.desc: From the wiki: "To obtain the Axe of Harming, the player must go to the bottom floor and find the tree with the loop in it. The player must stand near the corner of the nearest bookshelf and stare through the loop for a solid 15 seconds or so, and then a message will appear at the bottom left of the screen saying "UWU", giving the player the weapon."
items.name: Axe of Harming

items.desc:
It is found by using a Icon blood Blood spell on a blood-red skeleton southwest of the TV room. 

Upon hitting an enemy, the Blade of Jusztina is also able to restore the user's mana.
items.name: Blade of Jusztina

items.desc:
At the end of an invisible path at the Laetus Chasm.

Cannot block but instead it has stupidly high DPS.
items.name: Blessed Wind

items.desc: Complete Sheryl's quest in Boiling Grotto and the Musket will appear in her inventory.
items.name: Privateer Musket

items.desc:
Limbo is a sword made in Alchemy and its materials can be found during a full moon in real life (You can see the moon state by opening your character screen).
The ingredients required are:
- Broken Sword (appears only during full moon): Located right next to the sealed door at the very north.
- Fractured Life: Located behind a fake wall that requires you to use Icarian Flight to interact with it.
- Fractured Death: Located behind a fake wall in the Temple of Water, from the shortcut (west), keep heading northwest and interacting with the northern walls. Once in a small corridor, use Icarian Flight to get through the hole in the wall.

Used to obtain the Death Scythe.
items.location: Forlorn Arena (During a Full Moon) / Alchemy
items.name: Limbo

items.desc:
North of the lever, south of Maedemus, on the north east corridor, there will be a fake wall at west.
Here you'll enter a repeating hallway and you must enter the doors in the following order
North, North, South, North, South, South, North, South, North, North (NNSNNSSNSNN).
items.name: Serpent Fang

items.desc:
Available for purchase for 350 silver after defeating Sucsarius.

Required for one of the endings.
items.name: Jotunn Slayer

items.desc:
With the weapon "Limbo", kill Death in the Mausoleum.

Once done, the game will get harder until you evolve the Death Scythe (which resurrects Death). Dying in this state will permanently change your class to "Undead".
Not required for the achievement "Complete Arsenal", although there is a separate achievement for obtaining the evolved version of the scythe.
items.name: Death Scythe

items.location: Hollow Basin / Forbidden Archives: Milk Snails
items.name: Ice Sickle

items.desc: Can be evolved into the Dark Greatsword.
items.location: Hollow Basin, Temple of Silence: Mummy Knights / Yosei Forest
items.name: Rusted Sword

items.desc:
Affected by the real world moon phase. 
The damage it deals is lowest during a new moon, increasing the 'fuller' the current moon phase is. During a quarter moon it increases by ~255%, and during a full moon it skyrockets all the way to 475%. 
It drains 1% exp each swing.
items.name: Cursed Blade

items.desc: Can be evolved into the Lyrian Greatsword.
items.name: Lyrian Longsword

items.desc:
Obtained as a rare drop from Malformed Horses.

This sword has a durability system where the more you use it the less effective it becomes. You can "Evolve it" to repair the sword.
items.name: Brittle Arming Sword

items.desc: You can either get an Obsidian Cursebrand or an Obsidian Poisonguard. Whichever you get, you can swap to the other one by using the oil fountain where you evolve the weapons. Doing this has no cost.
items.name: Obsidian Cursebrand

items.desc: You can either get an Obsidian Cursebrand or an Obsidian Poisonguard. Whichever you get, you can swap to the other one by using the oil fountain where you evolve the weapons. Doing this has no cost.
items.name: Obsidian Poisonguard

items.desc: Skeletons can be found in The Fetid Mire, The Sanguine Sea, The Accursed Tomb, Boiling Grotto, Tower of Abyss and Terminus Prison.
items.name: Skeleton Axe

items.desc: Low firerate but a lot more damage than the Twisted Staff.
items.name: Jailor's Candle

items.desc: Deals dark damage.
items.name: Sucsarian Dagger

items.desc: Deals Dark damage.
items.name: Sucsarian Spear

items.desc:
During Halloween, find the skull altar in The Fetid Mire and hit it with a fire weapon/spell. This will spawn a boss that when defeated will drop the weapon.

Not required for the achievement.
items.name: Cavalry Saber

items.desc: If you want to get more than one ending in a single run, either ignore the VHS quest or don't get all of the required spells as those are the requirements for ending E, which invalidates the normal ending.
items.name: !! IMPORTANT !!

items.desc:
Casts a flaming javelin towards the target. 

From the Hollow Basin Crystal, head South East to where Demi was.
items.name: Flame Spear

items.desc:
Summons a spectral orb of light that follows the caster, lighting up the area around them. 

From the Flame Spear, keep heading south east. You'll find the Spell Ring in a northern wall.
items.name: Ghost Light

items.desc:
Summons a stationary, floating flame in front of the caster that damages nearby enemies. 

Found at the end of a northern bridge, north east, in the Temple of Silence (Hollow Basin).
items.name: Flame Flare

items.desc:
Gives life to inanimate objects. Has no practical use. 

Next to the Altar in the Temple of Silence (hollow Basin). West.
items.name: Lithomancy

items.desc:
Sprays a stream of the caster's blood at the target, dealing Poison damage. 

In the Temple of Silence, after you open the Mirage that goes to the fountain, go back (East) and head north past the corridor and the small room, head to the north east corridor and open the fake wall that leads to another corridor south.
items.name: Blood Strike

items.desc:
Casts a javelin of ice towards the target. 
From the Warp Crystal, head south, then west and in the corridor going north, look for the fake wall to the east.
items.name: Ice Spear

items.desc:
Summons a snake-like column of fire in front of the caster. 
The first book can be found in the Catacomb's Mausoleum.
items.name: Fire Worm

items.desc:
Allows the caster to see the thoughts of enemies. 
The second book can be found in the "A Holy Battleground".
items.name: Beastial Communion

items.desc:
Launches the caster forwards at a high velocity. 

Past the wooden bridge, keep going forwards the path that leads north west, you'll find Wind Dash near the end, close to the south east fake wall.
items.name: Wind Dash

items.desc: Summons a temporary Snail ally to fight for the caster.
items.name: Summon Snail

items.desc: Summons a temporary Kodama ally to fight for the caster.
items.name: Summon Kodama

items.desc:
Found in Wing's Rest after collecting all 35 Soul Candy during Halloween. 
Casts a pumpkin-shaped projectile that deals high damage on impact. 

Not required for the spells achievement nor ending.
items.name: Pumpkin Pop

items.desc:
Creates a protective wall in front of the caster. 

From the Wooden Bridge, head East and then all the way south.
items.name: Barrier

items.desc:
Sprays the caster's blood at the target, dealing no damage. 
Keep going through the upper area and once you stop being on top of branches but in flat ground, head north east to find it.
items.name: Blood Drain

items.desc:
Slowly heals a portion of the caster's health upon use. 	
Keep moving through the upper area, you'll find it near the end, before dropping down to where the Elfen Bow was.
items.name: Holy Warmth

items.desc:
Found in a present at Wing's Rest during Christmas. 
Spawns a Santa-shaped projectile that explodes on impact.
Can only be used on Christmas. 

Not required for the spells achievement nor ending.
items.name: Jingle Bells

items.desc:
Launches a large boulder towards the target. 
From the Mirage that is close to Patchouli, head north (past Patchouli) and then all the way east towards a plant bud. Use a Blood Spell on it to open the way.
items.name: Earth Strike

items.desc:
Reveals an enemy's health and elemental resistances.
From the underground entrance (non-mirage, character facing north), head east, south, and at the fork go slightly north past the bud then open the fake wall to the east.
items.name: Light Reveal

items.desc:
Casts a cloud of lingering toxic mist that damages & poisons enemies. 
From the start of the forest canopy, head East, south, north, and at the fork head east, continue south to find the ring.
items.name: Poison Mist

items.desc:
Casts sharp projectiles made of wind towards the target. 
From the Poison Mist ring, keep going through the path south that merges towards north and keep heading north east until you find the spell ring at the end of the path.
items.name: Wind Slicer

items.desc:
Transforms the caster into a corpse, killing them if not undead. 
From the Warp Crystal, head West, south and follow the path leading south towards east then all the way north into the elevator. Once at the upper floor, head northwest and open the fake wall to the east. Look towards the corpse until the music stops then exit to get the ring.
items.name: Corpse Transformation

items.desc:
Casts a bolt of lightning towards the target. 
From the Warp Crystal, head west past the entrance and into the hole in the wall up north (use coffin spell ring or smth else to get there). Once up there, head west, south and enter the room to the west.
items.name: Lightning

items.desc:
Spawns a moveable coffin in front of the caster. 
From the Catacombs entrance, Keep going north until you see a blue light, then head west facing the south wall. Eventually you'll see a blue light, go there to find the spell ring.
items.name: Coffin

items.desc:
Covers the floor underneath the caster in damaging spikes made out of ice. 
Near the end of the area, past the Rosetta Stone, south of the invisible path you'll find a fake wall with the spell ring in there.
items.name: Ice Tear

items.desc:
Calls forth a vertical beam of damaging moonlight for a short period. 
The third black book can be found in the Throne Chamber.
items.name: Moon Beam

items.desc:
Summons a temporary Fairy ally to fight for the caster. 
Found close to the north east corner of the map, on top of a rock.
items.name: Summon Fairy

items.desc:
Summons an Ice Sword familiar to fight for the caster, slowly draining their mana. 

From the underground entrance (player facing west or north), keep going north then east, north again and the first room south west that you find, the ring will be there. There will be a breakable door but as the name implies, just break it.
items.name: Summon Ice Sword

items.desc:
Fires a dark skull-shaped projectile at the target. 

Skeletons can be found in The Fetid Mire, The Sanguine Sea, The Accursed Tomb, Boiling Grotto, Tower of Abyss and Terminus Prison.
items.name: Dark Skull

items.desc:
Extends multiple large thorn-covered vines towards the target. 	
From the Entrance (player facing north), head west and all the way south. 
If you don't have the gate open, just head north, west and then all the way south.
items.name: Earth Thorn

items.desc:
Creates a temporary walkable surface in front of the caster. 

From the warp crystal, continue the path leading east and once you're "outside", go all the way south, east and then north. You'll find the spell ring in the large room with lava, at the south east corner.
items.name: Rock Bridge

items.desc:
Bypasses all immunities and decreases the target's fire resistance. 
At the Sand Tempill entrance (player facing east), head south towards the door, you'll find the spell ring in that chest. 
Alternatively, if that door is closed, find a way to get below underground to open said shortcut. Sorry for the lack of directions, this place is a literal maze and that's the literal end of the area.
items.name: Ignis Calor

items.desc:
Allows the caster to jump incredibly high for 2 seconds.
From the warp crystal (first of all, save cuz you might die here), head north east towards the corner and enter the first room south that you find. Drop down, get the ring and quickly equip it and use it to get out.
items.name: Icarian Flight

items.desc: Increases the caster's movement speed for 30 seconds.
items.name: Quick Stride

items.desc: Summons a damaging tornado that draws in nearby enemies, as well as the caster.
items.name: Tornado

items.desc:
Surrounds the caster in a ring of blue fire. 
Once you're in the upper floor, head south, west (to where the NPC is) and behind them (south) you'll find a fake wall with the ring.
If the door is closed, keep heading west all the way past two doors then go north to find the lever.
items.name: Blue Flame Arc

items.desc:
Creates a damaging pool of lava in front of the caster for 14 seconds. 
From the Warp Crystal, head east and south of the lever that opens the door. It's quite literally the end of the area so you won't miss it.
items.name: Lava Chasm

items.desc:
Teleports the caster to Wing's Rest. 
From the Warp Crystal, head west, all the way north and west past the bridges. Keep trying to head south west while also checking south east rooms to eventually find the spell ring.
items.name: Spirit Warp

items.desc: Casts an orb of slime towards the target.
items.name: Slime Orb

items.desc:
- You won't be able to get the achievement until after you reach Forlorn and it's also a Full Moon (Limbo)
- Sometimes the Alchemy UI will get messed up and show two random items as blank boxes. Don't worry, you did not mess anything up. Just make sure you have those two crafted.
items.name: !! IMPORTANT !!
Bomb

2 Ashes 
1 Fire Opal

items.location: Accursed Tomb: Cursed Painting / Forbidden Archives: Necronomicon

items.name: Snowflake Obsidian
items.desc: Used for: Crystal Shard, Wisp Heart
items.location: Accursed Tomb: Mi-go / Boiling Grotto: Ikurr'ilb

items.desc: Used for: Health Vial, Mana Vial, Holy Water
items.location: Yosei Forest: Light Beings / Crates and Barrels

items.desc:
Obtained by defeating Phantoms in the Mausoleum/Castle Le Fanu and the Poltergeists in the Castle

Used for: Spectral Candle, Wisp Heart

items.name: Moon Petals
items.desc:
Given by: Destroying Moon Flowers

Used for: Moonlight Vial, Fairy Moss, Wisp heart, Holy Water

items.name: Bloodweed
items.desc:
Given by: Destroying Bloodweeds

Used for: Fairy Moss, Poison Urn

items.name: Vampiric Ashes
items.desc:
Given by: Defeating vampires in Castle Le Fanu.

Used for: Nothing yet (version 2.2.0)

items.name: Fool's Gold
items.desc:
Given by: Killing Hallowed Husks.

Used for: Nothing yet (version 2.2.0)

items.name: Bones
items.desc:
Given by: Defeating Skeletons, Obsidian Skeletons and Embalmed.

Used for: Staff of Osiris

items.name: Fire Coral
items.desc:
Given by: Destroying Fire Corals in the Boiling Grotto

Used for: Nothing yet (version 2.2.0)

items.desc: Used for: Spectral Candle, Staff of Osiris

items.name: Fiddlehead
items.desc:
Given by: Breaking Fiddleheads in the Forlorn Arena

Used for: Nothing yet (version 2.2.0)
